title: World Bloom — With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail! — Episode4 I Know The Feeling

meta.Event: With Your Sights on Stardom, Set Sail!
meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's training continues as they each pursue their dreams. When they're called over to SEKAI by Rin and the others one day, they find an expansive new land awaiting them!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: The home of the person who the zombies said could tell us something about that phoenix should be just up ahead.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What should we do...?
We can't cross here.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But I'm seeing some buildings on the other side, so there must be a bridge or crossing somewhere...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I'm not seeing any.
This seems weird...

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie A
rows.Line:
The other side? Sure thing!
Get on my back!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I think that turtle is going to take them to the other side.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
Do you think we can also get a ride?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, so that's how we're supposed to cross...
That explains the lack of bridges around here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then, let's go see if one of the other turtles will give us a ride across to the other side!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, since that's probably our only option.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But they all look really busy...
I hope we can find one that isn't...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, let's split up and look for one who'd be willing to help us!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Riding on a turtle's back sounds heavenly. The thought of being rocked to sleep on the water is so... Zzz... Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, Luka! Don't doze off just thinking about it!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
This is unfortunate...
All the turtles appear to be busy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... But we need to get to the other side in order to learn more about that phoenix... We have to find a turtle who can help us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That said, we've basically talked to every turtle here already...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh? Look, there's another turtle over there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: You're right. What's it doing way over there...?

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: It seems to be staring at the river.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Why don't we try asking for a ride?
Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We're trying to get to the other side of the river... Could you possibly give us a ride?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What's going on?
He sounded so sad for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
He did.
That is somewhat concerning...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: But we must focus on getting across to the other side. Let us find a different turtle.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie B
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I already promised some other plushies that I'd carry them across.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm sorry for making such a sudden request.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: These turtles all seem very popular.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Anyway, let's meet back up with Tsukasa and the others... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That turtle's staring at the river again.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Yes, with a rather serious expression.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you think's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie B
rows.Line: He's scared of going in the water, but doesn't want to give up...

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie B
rows.Line: His dream has always been to carry people across the river on his back.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie B
rows.Line: But this big storm came by one day and caused the river to overflow. He's been too afraid to go back in the water ever since.

rows.Speaker: Turtle Plushie B
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry, I need to go.
I have an appointment to keep.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, okay... Sorry for interrupting your business.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That turtle. I'm worried about him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I know what he's going through...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He doesn't want to give up on what he loves, but is too afraid to act. I know that feeling all too well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Then, Nene...
If you're so worried, then why don't you try talking to him again?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You know what he seems to be going through, so you may be in a position to show him some real empathy.

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
I agree.
You should tell him how you felt back then.
